settings.title: Settings
settings.themeDescription: Choose between light and dark theme
settings.vibrationDescription: Enable haptic feedback on mobile devices
settings.soundsDescription: Play sounds for correct and incorrect answers
settings.optionsDelayDescription: A pause before the hint helps you remember better.
settings.spellModeEnabledDescription: During training, sometimes show a task to compose the {targetLang} word from shuffled letters (for words you know fairly well).
settings.spellMasteringThresholdDescription: Only words with this mastery level or higher can appear in the compose-word task (0 = any, 50 = learning+, 75 = mastered).
settings.typeModeEnabledDescription: During training, sometimes show a task to type the {targetLang} word in a field (for words you know well).
settings.typeMasteringThresholdDescription: Only words with this mastery level or higher can appear in the type-the-word task (e.g. 70 = well known).
settings.hideMorphInTrainingDescription: Hide compact word-form hints (noun gender / verb forms) on training cards.
settings.autoplayPronunciationDescription: Automatically play the foreign word pronunciation on training cards when the foreign side is shown or when the expected answer is in the foreign language.
settings.offlineAutoDownloadDescription: Download grammar and training cards in the background so you can study without internet. Refreshed at most once an hour when you open the home screen.
settings.verbFormProgressionDescription: Choose how far to include Jehle dictionary forms. Easier tenses stay in the mix. After you change this, new forms for the added tenses appear in the queue immediately as new cards (no calendar wait).
settings.notificationFrequencyDescription: How often to receive training reminders
